name: lemeng.inventory.snapshot.page
_note: 库存快照单页采集子管线（#1318 foreach 按页驱动）：每次迭代取一页（ITER_ITEM_PAGE_NUMBER），
写 staging chunk；空页写 1 行占位（is_placeholder=1），保证父侧「页到齐」判据成立。

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(code AS INTEGER) AS code, CAST(msg AS VARCHAR) AS msg
 FROM read_json_auto('/workspace/.duckle-raw/inv-page-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-p${ITER_ITEM_PAGE_NUMBER}.json')
 WHERE CAST(code AS INTEGER) <> 0

properties.message: inventory page ${ITER_ITEM_PAGE_NUMBER} 网关非 0 code（{rows} 条）：bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/inv-page-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-p${ITER_ITEM_PAGE_NUMBER}.json

properties.sql:
SELECT '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}' AS batch_id,
       CAST(${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK} AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST(${ITER_ITEM_PAGE_NUMBER} AS INTEGER) AS page_num,
CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(storehouse_num AS BIGINT) AS storehouse_num,
       CAST(storehouse_code AS VARCHAR) AS storehouse_code,
       CAST(storehouse_name AS VARCHAR) AS storehouse_name,
       CAST(item_num AS BIGINT) AS item_num,
       CAST(item_code AS VARCHAR) AS item_code,
       CAST(item_barcode AS VARCHAR) AS item_barcode,
       CAST(item_name AS VARCHAR) AS item_name,
       CAST(item_spec AS VARCHAR) AS item_spec,
       CAST(item_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_unit,
       CAST(inventory_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_quantity,
       CAST(inventory_assist_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_assist_quantity,
       CAST(inventory_use_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_use_quantity,
       CAST(inventory_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS inventory_money,
       CAST(carry_cost_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS carry_cost_price,
       CAST(sale_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS sale_price,
       CAST(difference_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS difference_quantity,
       CAST(difference_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS difference_money,
       CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS is_placeholder,
       CAST((SELECT count(*) FROM input) AS INTEGER) AS page_rows,
       CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS computed_at
FROM input
UNION ALL
-- 空页占位（issue #1318）：0 行是正常的页尾，但要留痕让父侧数「页到齐」
SELECT '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}' AS batch_id,
       CAST(${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK} AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST(${ITER_ITEM_PAGE_NUMBER} AS INTEGER) AS page_num,
CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS storehouse_num,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS storehouse_code,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS storehouse_name,
       CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS item_num,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS item_code,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS item_barcode,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS item_name,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS item_spec,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS item_unit,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_quantity,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_assist_quantity,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_use_quantity,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS inventory_money,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS carry_cost_price,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS sale_price,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS difference_quantity,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS difference_money,
       CAST(1 AS INTEGER) AS is_placeholder,
       CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS page_rows,
       CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS computed_at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM input)
